layerContract.cameraConvention: Orthographic camera at negativeZ looking+Z; positiveZ farther. Explicit sorting always applies.
layerContract.waterClipPolicy: Root/actual host camera-fill field below fixed worldHorizon; actual watercell region clipping for waves/shore, no new walkable water occupancy. Do not obscure boat/output.
layerContract.centralBoardProtection: Far/islet/framing sprites outside playable routes; no dense particles over devices.

productionPolicy: Six newly generated native sources. Only alpha cleanup/crop/uniform resize/registration/native composition; no old bitmap reuse, no RGB painting, no code-drawn production geometry.
